Markus said yes to roadmap v2 on 22 Nov 2026 05:47 Brisbane. Version 0 = proving run only (not the record): five nights of values, then registered for the record at the lock (12-13 Dec 2026) or at intake 1 (2-3 Jan 2027); after that nothing here changes (a change = a new id and one more try).
hypothesis: Does the Atlas trend rule work across world share markets, not only the US?
rules: Three slots of one third: SPY (US), EFA (developed, non-US), EEM (emerging). Each slot holds one third x E, where E is the Atlas rule at a 1.0 ceiling on that fund's own closes (families.atlas_exposure(closes, 1.0): E = min(1, votes/3 x min(1, 0.15 / 20-session volatility)); E below 0.10 = 0). The rest in BIL.
rebalance_day: first session of each month, and any session on which any fund's vote count changes
stops: 20% below the fill price on every holding (core_v1.STOP_PCT), placed by the twins engine
leverage: no borrowing: weights add to at most 100% (max_gross 1.0). Effective exposure above 1x only through 2x funds.
fills: decision after a session close, filled at the next session's open (twins engine = research_harness/harness/portfolio.simulate)
costs: one shared model for every line: twins.config.SHARE_COSTS = 0 commission, 2 bps half spread, 3 bps slippage per trade (estimates; monthly re-measure from the real accounts' fills is a later work order). Gearing only through 2x funds (SSO, QLD), whose borrowing cost is inside their price; no margin. Idle money in BIL (T-bills); plain cash earns 0.
window: forward only: version 1 from its registration (the lock, or intake 1) to 31 Dec 2027. A replay of history (roadmap v2, V2-02) is planned before the lock; until it reports, no backtest stands behind this line.
pass_bar: Roadmap Phase 4 as amended by roadmap v2 section 8 (January 2028), with the bars Markus agreed 20 Nov 2026: passes if, after costs, it matched or beat the S&P 500 (Y-SPX), or came within 2 points a year with a worst fall at least one third smaller, AND clears the luck check (deflated Sharpe >= 0.95, at least 60 days) counted against 22 tries. Roadmap v2: a single line is evidence, not a candidate for money; what can be promoted is a fund.
